subtitle: A Field Guide to Quantum Computing from the Bottom of the Universe
note: Canonical component manifest, aligned to the V10 manuscript chapter map (twelve chapters: the former Chapter 11 is split into Ch 11, The Fog Inside the Fortress, noise and decoherence, and Ch 12, The Fortress Inside the Fortress, error correction). Paths are relative to the site root; chapter-11/ remains the physical directory for both Ch 11 and Ch 12 files, so no URLs or QR targets break. quantum_measurement.html appears three times by design: Ch 4 (first look), Ch 11 (readout errors and mitigation), Ch 12 (capstone sandbox). The hub, the injected page chrome, and the QR codes all derive from this file.

chapters.label: PROLOGUE
chapters.title: Setting Out for the Bottom
chapters.blurb: Before the descent: the double-slit doorway, then a journey down through scale — grass to cell to atom to the Planck foam, where the meadow's first shimmers appear.

components.title: The descent to the meadow
components.desc: Travel down through powers of ten — blade of grass, cell, molecule, atom, nucleus, quark — until light fails, the instruments run out, and spacetime turns to foam. The first shimmers of superposition and entanglement appear at the bottom.
components.teaches: scale · the Planck length · why the quantum world is hidden

chapters.title: The Smallest Meadow
chapters.blurb: Where it begins: the smallest unit of the world. A classical bit sits in one box; the quantum version is a cloud of where-it-might-be.

components.title: Bit vs qubit
components.desc: A classical pebble sits in the 0 box or the 1 box. A qubit is a smeared cloud over both at once — toggle between them. No Bloch angles, no maths, just the leap.

components.title: The cloud of where
components.desc: A Gaussian wavefunction's |ψ|² as a brightness map — where you're likely to find the particle. A gentle picture of probability before any formalism.

chapters.title: The Dance of Both-and
chapters.blurb: Both-and, not either-or. The Bloch sphere gives the cloud a home, where amplitudes become odds and a measurement finally picks one.

components.title: Superposition on the Bloch sphere
components.desc: The smeared cloud of possibility: amplitudes become Born-rule probabilities, phase sweeps without changing the odds, and a measurement collapses it.

chapters.title: The Silent Duet
chapters.blurb: Two clouds, one inseparable state — a duet sung in silence. From the artistic scene, through Bell and CHSH, to an exact Schrödinger evolution.

components.title: The artistic scene
components.desc: Two clouds touch, interact, drift apart, joined by a metaphorical thread; measure one spin and the pair collapses into anti-correlation.

components.title: The two-particle joint density
components.desc: The rigorous thread: |Ψ(x₁,x₂)|² collapsing onto the anti-diagonal as correlation r → −1, while the single-particle marginals never move.

components.title: Bell correlation on the singlet
components.desc: Empirical anti-correlation converging onto cos²(Δθ/2), bowing above the best local-realist line — the gap no hidden-variable theory can close.

components.title: CHSH & Tsirelson's bound
components.desc: The CHSH combination |S| climbing past the classical limit of 2 toward 2√2 ≈ 2.83 at the optimal detector angles.

components.title: Coupled real & configuration space
components.desc: One clock drives both pictures: clouds separate in real space while the joint density splits into two anti-diagonal lobes.

components.title: Exact free-particle evolution
components.desc: A genuine time-dependent Schrödinger solution: ballistic separation, σ(t) spreading, and real momentum-interference fringes.

chapters.title: The Footfall
chapters.blurb: The footfall lands: a spread-out state becomes one definite outcome, drawn by the Born rule — and the world keeps listening, the first whisper of decoherence.

components.title: Wavefunction collapse
components.desc: Measurement collapses |ψ⟩ to a single eigenstate |r₀⟩, sampled by P = |⟨r₀|ψ⟩|²; repeat the trial and the |ψ|² distribution rebuilds itself.

components.title: Measurement & noise — first look
components.desc: The measurement sandbox, here as a first encounter with how a real device samples outcomes and how noise creeps in. The density matrix is introduced qualitatively; its full treatment is in Ch 11.

chapters.title: From Pebbles to Qubits
chapters.blurb: From a vague cloud to a precise instrument: the qubit as a vector on the Bloch sphere, the 2ᴺ explosion of Hilbert space, and interference — the engine underneath everything that follows.

components.title: One qubit, three bodies
components.desc: The same state |ψ⟩ realised as a spin, a superconducting transmon, and a photon's polarisation — the qubit is the state, not the hardware.

components.title: The Bloch sphere
components.desc: A single-qubit state as a point on the sphere, set by the two angles θ and φ — the full parameterisation the rest of the book draws on.

components.title: The exponential ballroom
components.desc: How Hilbert space grows: each new qubit does not add a room, it doubles every room that exists. Watch the dimension race past the atoms in the observable universe by thirty dancers.
components.teaches: tensor product · 2ⁿ scaling · the exponential ballroom

components.title: Quantum wave interference
components.desc: Amplitudes add, not probabilities. The cross-term 2·Re(ψ₁*ψ₂) paints constructive and destructive fringes that depend on relative phase.

chapters.title: The Gentle Art of Nudging
chapters.blurb: Steering the cloud. Every single-qubit gate is a rigid turn of the Bloch vector; compose a few and you can point the state anywhere.

components.title: Gates as Bloch-sphere rotations
components.desc: H, X, Y, Z, S, T as rotations about fixed axes — then compose a sequence (H then Z) and watch the net turn the qubit makes.

components.title: Nudge a cloud — the quantum coin
components.desc: Drop an H gate to tilt |0⟩ to the equator, add a measurement, and let the footfalls land 50/50 — true quantum randomness from one gate.

chapters.title: The Choreographed Chorus
chapters.blurb: Make the right answer shout. Superposition, an oracle, and a diffuser turn √N steps of interference into a found needle — no entanglement required.

components.title: Interference — the engine of the search
components.desc: Do it yourself: superpose, flip the phase of the marked item (oracle), mirror across the mean (diffuser), repeat — and watch over-rotation undo it.

components.title: Oracle, diffuser & amplification
components.desc: The operator-level view: Uω as a sign flip, D = 2|ψ⟩⟨ψ| − I as reflection about the mean, and P(ω) = sin²((2k+1)θ) with the optimal iteration count.

chapters.title: The Secret of Rhythm
chapters.blurb: Factoring as listening for a rhythm. A classical clock hides a period; the Quantum Fourier Transform makes it ring out; a measurement gives up the secret.

components.title: The clockwork maze
components.desc: Modular exponentiation aˣ mod N around a ring — the colour pattern repeats every r steps, and that hidden period r is what Shor must find.

components.title: The QFT resonance sweep
components.desc: A periodic comb in the index domain becomes sharp peaks at k = jM/r in frequency — how the Quantum Fourier Transform makes the period readable.

components.title: The pillars of light
components.desc: Measure a pillar, then continued fractions recover r and gcd(a^{r/2}±1, N) gives the factors of N.

chapters.title: The Mirror of the Meadow
chapters.blurb: A hybrid loop holds a quantum mirror up to a molecule and tunes it until its energy sinks to the ground state. Open them in order 9.1 → 9.3 → 9.2 → 9.4 → 9.5 → 9.6.

components.title: H₂ molecular energy landscape
components.desc: The energy-vs-bond-length curve with its minimum — the target VQE will hunt for. No quantum-computing prerequisites.

components.title: Hardware-efficient ansatz circuit
components.desc: The parameterised trial-state factory: two Ry(θ) rotations + a CNOT entangler + measurement, with θ₁,θ₂ the tunable knobs. (Read before 9.2.)

components.title: VQE convergence curve
components.desc: The loop in action: a classical optimiser nudges θ, the quantum processor reports the energy, and E(θ) ≥ E₀ drives it down to the ground state.

components.title: Measurement outcome probabilities
components.desc: Sampling the converged state gives a bitstring histogram dominated by the ground configuration (θ* = 0 → |00⟩ with probability 1).

components.title: Variational parameter landscape
components.desc: Energy as a 2-D surface E(θ₁,θ₂) with minima, maxima and saddles; gradient descent walks downhill — and barren plateaus threaten at scale.

components.title: Tuning the mirror
components.desc: The capstone lab: drag θ to move the energy point, watch the histogram shift, then auto-tune and watch the optimiser converge to θ = 0.

chapters.title: The Fog in the Wilderness
chapters.blurb: A fog of probability poured over a wilderness of possible answers, tuned until it condenses over the deepest valley. Annealing lets it settle; QAOA shapes it, angle by angle.

components.title: The slow melt — quantum annealing
components.desc: Adiabatic interpolation H(s) = (1−s)H_M + sH_C: a melting double-well where the mist settles into the deeper valley, if you sweep slowly through the minimum-gap bottleneck.

components.title: Shaping the mist — QAOA Max-Cut
components.desc: The gate-model sequel: cost phase γ and mixer angle β across p layers concentrate probability on the bitstrings that maximise a Max-Cut objective.

chapters.title: The Fog Inside the Fortress
chapters.blurb: The reality check. Real qubits leak energy, lose their timing, let the duet fade, and lie at readout. Density matrices, T₁ and T₂, and the slow silencing of entanglement: the fog no refrigerator can fully keep out.

components.title: The mixed state
components.desc: Drag a qubit from the surface of the Bloch sphere into the ball: the density matrix ρ, populations vs coherences, and purity Tr(ρ²) falling from 1 toward ½.

components.title: T₁ and T₂
components.desc: The two decay channels: T₁ relaxation (energy loss, the vector climbs to the pole) and T₂ dephasing (phase loss, the vector collapses onto the axis).

components.title: Decoherence of entanglement
components.desc: The same channels on a Bell pair: coherences fade, population drains into |00⟩, and the concurrence — entanglement itself — dies. Entanglement is fragile.

components.title: Readout lies, and how to catch them
components.desc: Dial up the readout error rate, inspect the confusion matrix, and toggle mitigation on and off. The histogram sharpens as the lies are inverted away, one of the most practical tools in the NISQ kit.
components.teaches: readout error · confusion matrix · error mitigation

chapters.title: The Fortress Inside the Fortress
chapters.blurb: The counter-attack. How do you fix an error you cannot look at, in a state you cannot copy? Parity checks that never touch the cloud, the repetition code, the surface code, and the threshold where correction finally outpaces creation.

components.title: Fighting back: the repetition code
components.desc: Spread one logical bit across three physical qubits; a single flip is caught and majority-voted away. Below threshold redundancy wins; above it, it hurts.

components.title: Surface code & the threshold
components.desc: Logical vs physical error over code distance d: below the ~1% threshold, bigger codes suppress logical error exponentially; above it, encoding makes things worse.

components.title: The full sandbox
components.desc: Everything at once — depth, gate error, T₁, readout, mitigation, surface code — with a verdict on every run: recoverable, lost, or needs error correction.

extras.title: The CNOT wingman
extras.desc: Build a Bell state by feeding a superposed control into a CNOT — the gate that makes entanglement. (Not on the main V5 path; kept for reference.)

extras.title: Spooky action at the kitchen table
extras.desc: A gate-model Bell state with H + CNOT; measure one qubit and the other answers instantly. (Off the main path; overlaps the Ch 3 entanglement set.)

extras.title: Quantum search explained for everyone
extras.desc: The plain-English on-ramp to Grover — needle, haystack, √N speed-up. (Off the main path; the Ch 7 labs carry this now.)

extras.title: Quantum entanglement — the all-in-one composite
extras.desc: All six entanglement scenes on one scrolling page, from metaphor to exact Schrödinger evolution. A long-form companion to the Chapter 3 set.

extras.title: Voronoi tessellation in 3-D
extras.desc: A simplified visualisation of spatial partitioning — a geometry aside kept off the core learning path.
